stories.title: Gauteng's Tiyani Makamu crowned Miss SA 2026
stories.summary: Tiyani Makamu from Gauteng has been crowned Miss South Africa 2026. The 27-year-old from Bronkhorstspruit was crowned at the Sandton Convention Centre in Johannesburg.
stories.angle: This celebrates the achievement of a young South African woman.

stories.title: Cape Town team prepares for South Africaâs first pioneering epilepsy procedure
stories.summary: A pioneering stereo-EEG procedure is being prepared in Cape Town by a multidisciplinary team. This technique offers new possibilities for patients whose epileptic seizures cannot be controlled with medication.
stories.angle: This represents significant medical progress for South Africa, offering new hope for epilepsy patients.
